paite: Moab gam puakgik. Zan khat thu in Moab gam a Ar khua suksiat in a-om a, bangmah lou a bawl in a-omta hi; zan khat thu in Moab gam a Kir khua suksiat in a-om a, bangmah lou a bawl in a-omta hi.
heading: Pathian In Moab Ahihse Ding
english: The burden of Moab: for in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing; for in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing.

paite: Dibon tanu, mun sangte a kap ding in ahohtouta a; Moabte'n Nebo leh Medeba akahkhum ua, alu tengteng uh agiau vek a, akhamul teng uh leng met in a-om vek hi.
english: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.

paite: Akongzingte uah sai-ip puan ateng ua; a-intungte uah leh akholak uah michih nakpi in amau tuaituai uhi.
english: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.

paite: Heshbonte leng akikou ua, Elealehte toh; Jahaz kholam in leng a-aw uh aza uh; huaiziak in Moabte galvan a kivante ngaihtak in akikou ua; ahinna uh asung uah aling hi.
english: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.

paite: Moabte ziak in ka lungtang akikou a; amihoihte uh Zoar leh Eglath-shelishijah khuate ah atai ua; Luhith tou ah kap kawm in apaitou ua; Horonaim lampi ah siatna kikou in akikoukhia uhi.
english: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for in the way of Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.

paite: Nimrim tuite hihsiat a om ding ahi; loupa avuai khinta; loupa selnoute avuai a, thil hing a-omta kei hi.
english: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.

paite: Huaiziak in asum neihsunte uleh akoih hoihte uh Muisum Lui gal akaimangpih uhi.
english: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.

paite: Moab gamgi kim ah kikou husa athang ngal a; amau tuaituai husa Eglaim khua atungta; amau tuaituai husa Beer-elim khua atungta hi.
english: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab; its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.

paite: Dimon tuite sisan in adim vek ngal a; Dimon tung ah thil thupi sem tungsak ding ka hi, Moabte lak a taikhete tung ah leh huai gam a khosuaksunte tung ah humpinelkai ka tungsak ding hi.
english: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.
